facts: The paper 'Sharp Stability of Brenier Potentials and its Link to Poincaré Inequalities' was authored by Cyril Letrouit and Tudor Manole.
The paper was published on arXiv on October 27, 2026, under ID arxiv:2610.37659.
The authors prove a new functional inequality for uniformly log-concave measures that is stronger than the Poincaré inequality.
The new functional inequality bounds the variance of differences of convex functions.
The work provides a sharp stability bound for Brenier potentials relative to variations of the target measure, given a fixed uniformly log-concave source measure.

The authors apply their inequality to Gaussian measures to recover the equivalence between the Bures-Wasserstein distance of positive semidefinite matrices and the Frobenius distance of their square roots.
The mathematical proofs rely on linearization arguments for the Monge-Ampère equation governing quadratic optimal transport.
